nodes.lead: Each computer runs one node. You decide how much each AI may do in each project.
nodes.empty.title: No computers connected yet
nodes.empty.body: Connect a computer first. Each computer runs one node and keeps the groups and AIs you put on it.
nodes.relay.title: Using a relay — speed and data are limited.
nodes.relay.body: Chats and task messages work as usual; terminal takeover is unavailable until a direct connection opens.
nodes.hosts.warnOne: This computer is the home of 1 group — keep it on.
nodes.hosts.warn: This computer is the home of {n} groups — keep it on.
nodes.hosts.body: While it is off, messages in its groups cannot be sent or received until it comes back.
nodes.ai.offline: Offline · wakes when the computer returns
nodes.ai.nogroups: Not in any project group yet
nodes.pair.title: Add a browser or phone
nodes.pair.lead: Create a one-time link on one of your computers, then open it in the browser or on the phone you want to add.
nodes.pair.expires: Expires in {n} min ({time}) and works once.
